title: SORCERER: gaunt man, 50s, shaved head, tattered ash-grey robe whipping in wind…
content: SORCERER: gaunt man, 50s, shaved head, tattered ash-grey robe whipping in wind, barefoot on wet black sand, arms raised LEVIATHAN: colossal humanoid-serpentine entity, plated blue-black carapace streaked with pale coral, crown of splayed bone spurs, deep-set amber glow where eyes should be, 60 meters SITE: black volcanic beach at dusk, storm ceiling, distant basalt cliffs, ribs of wrecked ships buried in the sand Live action, anamorphic 35mm, cold blue-black palette with a single amber source. Storm light, hard wind. BEAT 1 (0-5s): Low angle on wet black sand, handheld, slow push. SORCERER stands barefoot at the surf line, arms rising. Behind him the entire ocean tears backward, retreating hundreds of meters in seconds, dragging foam and exposing raw seabed, kelp, and the ribs of buried wrecks. Seabirds scatter inland. He does not move. BEAT 2 (5-10s): The withdrawn water gathers on the horizon into a black wall. Camera holds low and close to the sand, does not retreat. Amber light ignites deep inside the wall, immense, resolving into two points. The wall bursts. LEVIATHAN's crowned skull breaches and keeps rising past the top of frame, hauling a mountain of seawater with it. BEAT 3 (10-15s): Slow deliberate TILT UP along the entity's torso as it rises to full height and stops. Absolutely still. Water sheets off its carapace in continuous roaring curtains for the entire beat. The amber eyes angle down. Far below, SORCERER holds his ground on the sand as the returning surge slams in around his ankles, robe torn sideways by the wind. Camera stays low, never pulls back. Practical storm light, volumetric spray, real water weight and inertia, hundreds of thousands of tons of displacement. No slow motion. No wide establishing shot. No pull-back. No stone platforms or geometric structures rising from the sand.

fr.content:
SORCIER : homme émacié, la cinquantaine, crâne rasé, robe en lambeaux gris cendre fouettée par le vent, pieds nus sur le sable noir mouillé, bras levés  
LÉVIATHAN : entité humanoïde-serpentine colossale, carapace bleu-noir plaquée striée de corail pâle, couronne d’épines osseuses écartées, lueur ambrée profonde là où devraient se trouver les yeux, 60 mètres  
LIEU : plage volcanique noire au crépuscule, plafond d’orage, falaises basaltiques au loin, côtes de navires naufragés enfouies dans le sable  
Action réelle, anamorphique 35 mm, palette froide bleu-noir avec une seule source ambrée. Lumière d’orage, vent violent.  
TEMPS FORT 1 (0-5 s) : Angle bas sur le sable noir mouillé, caméra à l’épaule, lent mouvement d’approche. SORCIER se tient pieds nus à la ligne de ressac, les bras se levant. Derrière lui, tout l’océan se déchire en arrière, se retirant de plusieurs centaines de mètres en quelques secondes, entraînant l’écume et révélant le fond marin brut, le varech et les côtes de navires enfouies. Les oiseaux de mer s’envolent vers l’intérieur des terres. Il ne bouge pas.  
TEMPS FORT 2 (5-10 s) : L’eau retirée se rassemble à l’horizon en un mur noir. La caméra reste basse et proche du sable, ne recule pas. Une lumière ambrée s’allume au plus profond du mur, immense, se résolvant en deux points. Le mur éclate. Le crâne couronné de LÉVIATHAN émerge et continue de monter au-delà du haut du cadre, emportant avec lui une montagne d’eau de mer.  
TEMPS FORT 3 (10-15 s) : TILT UP lent et délibéré le long du torse de l’entité tandis qu’elle atteint sa pleine hauteur puis s’immobilise. Absolument immobile. L’eau ruisselle de sa carapace en rideaux continus et tonitruants pendant toute la durée du temps fort. Les yeux ambrés s’abaissent. Tout en bas, SORCIER tient bon sur le sable tandis que la vague de retour s’abat autour de ses chevilles, sa robe arrachée de côté par le vent. La caméra reste basse, ne recule jamais. Lumière d’orage pratique, embruns volumétriques, poids et inertie réels de l’eau, déplacement de centaines de milliers de tonnes. Pas de ralenti. Pas de plan large d’établissement. Pas de recul. Pas de plateformes de pierre ni de structures géométriques surgissant du sable.

ko.content:
SORCERER: 수척한 남자, 50대, 삭발한 머리, 바람에 휘날리는 해진 잿빛 로브, 젖은 검은 모래 위 맨발, 팔을 들어 올린 자세  
LEVIATHAN: 거대한 인간형-뱀형 존재, 옅은 산호빛이 스친 청흑색 판갑형 외골격, 벌어진 뼈 돌기들로 이루어진 왕관, 눈이 있어야 할 자리의 깊숙한 곳에서 타오르는 호박색 빛, 60미터  
SITE: 황혼의 검은 화산 해변, 폭풍 구름 천장, 멀리 보이는 현무암 절벽, 모래에 묻힌 난파선의 뼈대  
실사, 아나모픽 35mm, 단 하나의 호박색 광원을 둔 차갑고 청흑색 팔레트. 폭풍의 빛, 거센 바람.  
BEAT 1 (0-5s): 젖은 검은 모래를 낮은 앵글로, 핸드헬드, 천천히 푸시 인. SORCERER는 파도선 위에서 맨발로 서서 팔을 들어 올린다. 그의 뒤로 바다가 통째로 뒤로 찢겨 나가듯, 몇 초 만에 수백 미터나 물러나며 거품을 끌고 가고, 드러난 거친 해저와 다시마, 그리고 묻혀 있던 난파선의 뼈대를 노출시킨다. 바닷새들은 내륙으로 흩어진다. 그는 움직이지 않는다.  
BEAT 2 (5-10s): 물러난 바닷물이 수평선 위에서 검은 벽으로 모여든다. 카메라는 모래에 낮고 가깝게 고정된 채, 물러서지 않는다. 호박색 빛이 그 벽 깊숙한 곳에서 거대하게 점화되며, 두 개의 점으로 형체를 드러낸다. 벽이 폭발하듯 갈라진다. LEVIATHAN의 왕관을 쓴 해골이 수면을 뚫고 올라오며 프레임 상단을 넘어 계속 솟구치고, 그와 함께 산더미 같은 바닷물을 끌어올린다.  
BEAT 3 (10-15s): 존재의 몸통을 따라 천천히, 의도적으로 TILT UP 하며 그것이 완전한 높이까지 올라와 멈춘다. 완전히 정지. 물은 내내 포효하는 커튼처럼 외골격을 타고 끊임없이 흘러내린다. 호박색 눈이 아래를 향한다. 한참 아래에서 SORCERER는 모래 위에 굳건히 버티고 서 있고, 되돌아오는 쇄도가 그의 발목을 강타하며 로브를 옆으로 거세게 잡아챈다. 카메라는 낮게 유지되며, 결코 뒤로 물러서지 않는다. 실재하는 폭풍 조명, 볼류메트릭 스프레이, 실제 물의 무게와 관성, 수십만 톤의 변위. 슬로 모션 없음. 와이드한 설정 샷 없음. 풀백 없음. 모래에서 돌 플랫폼이나 기하학적 구조물이 솟아오르는 장면 없음.

Storm light, hard wind. BEAT 1 (0-5s): Low angle on wet black sand, handheld, slow push. SORCERER stands barefoot at the surf line, arms rising. Behind him the entire ocean tears backward, retreating hundreds of meters in seconds, dragging foam and exposing raw seabed, kelp, and the ribs of buried wrecks. Seabirds scatter inland. He does not move. BEAT 2 (5-10s): The withdrawn water gathers on the horizon into a black wall. Camera holds low and close to the sand, does not retreat. Amber light ignites deep inside the wall, immense, resolving into two points. The wall bursts. LEVIATHAN's crowned skull breaches and keeps rising past the top of frame, hauling a mountain of seawater with it. BEAT 3 (10-15s): Slow deliberate TILT UP along the entity's torso as it rises to full height and stops. Absolutely still. Water sheets off its carapace in continuous roaring curtains for the entire beat. The amber eyes angle down. Far below, SORCERER holds his ground on the sand as the returning surge slams in around his ankles, robe torn sideways by the wind. Camera stays low, never pulls back. Practical storm light, volumetric spray, real water weight and inertia, hundreds of thousands of tons of displacement. No slow motion. No wide establishing shot. No pull-back. No stone platforms or geometric structures rising from the sand.

zh.content:
术士：瘦削男子，50多岁，剃光头，破烂的灰烬色长袍在风中猎猎作响，赤脚站在湿黑沙滩上，双臂高举  
利维坦：巨大的类人蛇形实体，覆有蓝黑色甲壳，表面带有浅珊瑚色条纹，张开的骨刺构成冠冕，眼睛所在处是深陷的琥珀色幽光，高 60 米  
场景：黄昏时分的黑色火山海滩，低压风暴云层，远处玄武岩峭壁，埋在沙中的沉船肋骨 Live action，anamorphic 35mm，冷调蓝黑配色，唯一的琥珀色光源。风暴光，强风。  
BEAT 1 (0-5s): 湿黑沙滩的低角度镜头，手持，缓慢推进。术士赤脚站在浪线处，双臂缓缓抬起。身后整片海洋向后撕裂，几秒内退去数百米，卷走泡沫，露出裸露的海床、海带，以及埋藏沉船的肋骨。海鸟向内陆四散飞去。他一动不动。  
BEAT 2 (5-10s): 退去的海水在地平线上聚成一道黑色高墙。镜头保持低位，贴近沙面，不后退。琥珀色光芒在墙体深处点燃，巨大无比，逐渐显现为两个光点。高墙炸裂。利维坦戴冠的头骨破水而出，并继续上升，冲出画面上方，连同一座海水山峰一起被拖起。  
BEAT 3 (10-15s): 缓慢而刻意地沿着实体躯干向上 TILT UP，直到它升至全高并停住。绝对静止。整个镜头段内，海水从它的甲壳上成片倾泻而下，形成持续轰鸣的瀑布。琥珀色的眼睛向下斜视。远处下方，术士站在沙地上纹丝不动，回涌的浪潮拍打到他脚踝四周，长袍被风向一侧撕扯。镜头始终保持低位，绝不拉远。实拍风暴光、体积喷雾、真实的水体重量与惯性、数十万吨级的位移。不要慢动作。不要广角建立镜头。不要拉远。不要有石质平台或从沙中升起的几何结构。
